KPlugin.Name: PlasmaFlipLock
KPlugin.Description: Minimal Fliqlo-style flip-clock lock screen for KDE Plasma 6 (KScreenLocker). Blurred wallpaper, huge mechanical flip clock, date, battery and glass password panel.

X-PlasmaFlipLock.Comment: This file is informational metadata for the lock screen contents. The runtime entry point used by kscreenlocker_greet is LockScreen.qml in this directory (the 'lockscreenmainscript' definition of the Plasma shell package). The shell package's own metadata.json (one directory up) governs package identity and X-Plasma-APIVersion. To uninstall: run uninstall.sh.
X-PlasmaFlipLock.Requires: kscreenlocker_greet (Plasma 6.4+ recommended; <=6.3 supported through compatibility glue)
